description.value:
While adjacent to a Skymetal Pool, you can use this action to coat an unarmed attack or a weapon you're wielding with the pool's metal(s). This causes it to count as the metal(s) contained in the pool on its next successful Strike within 1 minute, after which the coating wears off.

Alternatively, you can add the spellshape or infusion trait to this action, causing instead your next spell or impulse to count as the appropriate metal(s).
